summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K reporting the execution of the third tranche of its share buyback program. The filing details transactions from May 6-8, 2026, managed by Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG. Cash spent to date in this tranche is €79,292,603, representing 5.43% of the maximum cash amount allocated. This is an ongoing open-market buyback, not a tender offer or special dividend. The program reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders. Watch for progress updates and total completion versus the authorized cap. There is no risk-arb angle here as it is a routine buyback, not a control event.
